name: IM-1 Odysseus

narrator.name: Odysseus
narrator.role: the first private lander to touch down

intro: Hey there! I'm Odysseus, nicknamed Odie, built by a company from Texas.
If I make it, I'll be the first American lander since Apollo 17 in 1972!
Target: Malapert A, near the south pole.
Engineers forgot to switch on my laser rangefinders. Oops.
briefing: We're borrowing a NASA test laser to find our way down!
fact: Odie landed, but tipped onto its side. It still sent data for a week!

alarm.title: Lasers Offline
alarm.briefing: Our laser rangefinders were never switched on! We're patching in a NASA test instrument. Choose the landing site!
